title: Merge Two Sorted Lists
description: You are given the heads of two sorted linked lists list1 and list2. Merge the two lists into one sorted list, and return the head of the merged list. The list should be made by splicing together the nodes of the first two lists.
hints: Compare the two current heads and always take the smaller one.
A dummy head node avoids tedious special-casing of the first node.
solution_approach: Use a dummy node as the start. Keep two pointers on the current node of each list; append the smaller value node and advance that list. When one list is exhausted, append the remainder of the other. Either iterative with two pointers or recursive.
space_complexity: O(1) iterative, O(N + M) recursion stack
common_mistakes: Forgetting to connect trailing nodes after one list runs out.
Losing the reference to the real head when using dummy nodes.
